Tamil Nadu Agriculture Budget faces criticism and mixed reactions

Tamil Nadu's Agriculture Budget for 2026-27 has drawn criticism from farmers' bodies and mixed reactions from trade groups. Farmers have voiced disappointment, stating the budget misses key promises and includes a cut in agriculture allocation, with some expressing that their hopes have "withered just like our crops." The government, however, highlighted its focus on AI and machine learning for farmer aid. Separately, a CPI(M) MP questioned the practice of taking budget documents to a temple in Tirupati.
